title: Source and alignment checks for the coupled-snapshot deck
purpose: Every figure on the deck is regenerated from these saved files. These checks confirm reach, parameter and unit alignment across files before plotting, and re-derive the headline statistics.

checks.detail: results.json['design'] is byte-equal to design.json after key sorting
8 names in one order across recovery, joint_jacobian, discharge_only, concentration_only, posterior, weak_control; plots index by name, never by row position
exp(theta) reproduces the 6 positive natives (multipliers, 1/day decay); the 2 storage amplitudes are signed and untransformed
30 training COMIDs identical and in the same order as design.json train_comids
10 held-out COMIDs identical and in the same order as design.json holdout_comids
n_train=30 (design 30), n_holdout=10 (design 10), no shared reach
40 distinct COMIDs; every plotted point is keyed on its COMID, not a row number
west/east training split [15, 15] equals design.train_region_counts; region is the longitude class, not a hydrologic basin
every row's region_1based agrees with its longitude against the median split -96.3058 deg (ties east)
observed == truth exactly for all 30 training rows, matching design.generated_noise = NONE
all 10 held-out rows have empty observation columns; results.json hard check holdout_never_in_objective = True
train: discharge RMSE 3.051154 m3/s vs recorded 3.051154; concentration RMSE 0.02003634 mg/L vs recorded 0.02003634
holdout: discharge RMSE 4.336801 m3/s vs recorded 4.336801; concentration RMSE 0.01189181 mg/L vs recorded 0.01189181
log RMSE / sigma reproduces the reported noise-scaled values with sigma_Q=0.0998, sigma_C=0.1980 (assumed likelihood, not generated noise)
prior-mean columns give train log RMSE 0.249847 (Q) and 0.363784 (C), equal to pre_fit.prior_mean_vs_truth_at_train
max relative spread across the three starts at any of the 40 reaches is 1.33e-08; parameter-space spread 2.12e-08 prior sd. One curve is plotted for all three
discharge 0.275-9527.7 m^3/s over drainage 30-639079 km^2; concentration 0.108-1.206 mg/L, consistent with the 1 mg/L reference field and units m^3/s / mg/L
held-out truths span 8.66-2598 m^3/s and 0.108-1.133 mg/L, matching the ranges quoted in the experiment report
67 saved arrays, none named for a time axis; every field is one steady snapshot (design.forward_model is pure algebra). Decay rates carry 1/day units only
reach-indexed arrays have length 64579 = design.n_reaches for outlet COMID 74072654
docs/COUPLED_SNAPSHOT.md and docs/EQUATION42.md still hash to the SHA-256 recorded in design.json at run time, so the method text quoted here is the text the run used
design.json records SHA-256 for the forward model, runner, tests and docs used in the run; those digests are republished unchanged

not_checked_here: The physics of Equation 42's storage terms; these are file-alignment and arithmetic checks only.
Any real measurement: the observations are synthetic and noise-free by construction.
Posterior calibration: the Gauss-Newton covariance is a local linearisation, not a sampled posterior.
